Adaptive Feature Grids, also known as APMGSRN, was introduced to address the inefficiency of fixed uniform grid placement in neural volume representations.
It builds on the concept of hash grids but introduces spatial adaptivity through learnable transformation matrices and feature density loss.
The method is particularly relevant for scientific volume data, where high-fidelity reconstruction at high compression ratios is essential.
